ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What event will probably cause the elephant seal population to increase?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The food-web diagram shows an elephant seal on the right side. A fish is shown below and slightly left of the elephant seal, and an arrow points from the fish upward to the elephant seal, indicating that fish are a food source for elephant seals. Reasoning: The question asks what event would probably cause the elephant seal population to increase. In a food web, if a predator's food source increases, the predator population may also increase because more food is available. Since fish are shown as food for elephant seals, an increase in fish would probably increase the elephant seal population.
